copy.headline: They won’t declutter. Stage it anyway.
copy.caption:
Every agent has this listing. The seller has agreed to sell but not to move anything, and the photos go up Monday.

This dining room was photographed exactly as it stood. The clutter came out and the room was staged in one pass. Same camera position, same light, no furniture rental, and nobody had to ask anyone to tidy up.

One honest note on which part is which. Staging an empty room is free on Stagify. Removing existing furniture and clutter first is a Stagify+ feature, because it runs two passes instead of one.

The listing photo is the only part of a showing that happens before anyone has committed an afternoon to it.

Virtually staged with Stagify.ai

devilsAdvocate.whyThisOne: The only candidate whose headline describes a situation the agent is standing in rather than a fact they might find interesting. Furniture removal has never been posted; the account has shipped core staging, style presets, prompt bar, exterior studio, floor plan and free tier only.
devilsAdvocate.whyItEarnsAClick: The post does not answer its own question. Whether the reconstruction survives on their own listing can only be learned by uploading one.
devilsAdvocate.howItDiffers: All nine previous posts open on an empty room and close on a furnished one. This runs the other direction, so the thumbnail is busy rather than bare.
devilsAdvocate.residualRisk: Furniture removal is Stagify+ only (virtual-staging-handler.js ANDs removeBool with isPro) while the CTA is try free. Resolved by disclosing the tier plainly in the caption.
devilsAdvocate.notableKill: i18 claimed the disclosure label is applied automatically. Verified false: readStampRequest in stamp-disclosure.js only enables the stamp when the flag is explicitly set, so it defaults off.

review.designChanges: Wipe steepened to 92/30 and the AFTER pill moved to a raised bottom-right corner anchor, both at the user’s direction. Corner anchoring is now the template default.
